subject: MAP draft — milestone owners, dependencies, and target-close options
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Chris Nolan <chris.nolan@novacorp.com>, Aisha B. <aisha.b@novacorp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft — milestone owners, dependencies, and target-close options

Thanks again for a productive discovery earlier today. As promised, attaching an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for NovaCorp capturing the milestones we discussed, proposed owners, key dependencies, and a couple of target-close windows. Quick summary and asks below.

Attachments: MAP_draft_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), cost-estimate_v1.pdf (pdf)

Draft milestones (top-level):
- Pilot kickoff (Redwood SE + NovaCorp Eng) — owner: Jordan Blake / Claudia (NovaCorp)
- Pilot evaluation & metrics collection — owner: NovaCorp Product
- Security review & contract (SOC2 review, DPA) — owner: Aisha B. (Procurement)
- Production rollout & enablement — owner: NovaCorp Ops

Dependencies called out in the draft:
- Shared SOC2 evidence (approx timeline: next week)
- Network allowlist for test cluster (NovaCorp infra)
- Purchase order / standard T&Cs covered by procurement

Target-close options (pick one):
- Option A: July 23, 2026 (aggressive; requires SOC2 evidence and PO by Jun 25)
- Option B: Aug 6, 2026 (conservative; allows one additional validation sprint)

Asks: Please confirm by EOD Friday, May 28:
1) Who should be the confirmed owner for each milestone (I listed suggested owners in the spreadsheet).
2) Which target-close option you prefer (we can compress or expand based on your preference).
3) Any additional dependencies we should add (third-party approvals, procurement cadence, legal redlines).

I'll loop in Monica to revise the sheet once we have your inputs — she'll also refresh the cost estimate if the pilot scope changes.

Thanks — talk soon.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0178

--

Jordan — thanks for sending this over and for the call. Quick responses inline and a couple of updates from our side.

> Draft milestones (top-level):
> - Pilot kickoff — owner: Jordan Blake / Claudia (NovaCorp)
> - Pilot evaluation & metrics collection — owner: NovaCorp Product
> - Security review & contract (SOC2 review, DPA) — owner: Aisha B.
> - Production rollout & enablement — owner: NovaCorp Ops

All good except: please add our Security lead as an explicit owner for the SOC2 evidence intake: Markus Lee <markus.lee@novacorp.com> (Security). Claudia will be the Pilot PM.

We'd like to add a short "Pilot scope confirmation" milestone between kickoff and evaluation to ensure success criteria are locked before data collection begins.

As for timing, we prefer the July 23 window (Option A) if Redwood can commit to a one-week acceleration on the SOC2 evidence intake and a draft SOW this week. We'll aim to provide the SOC2 artifacts by May 26.

Also: procurement questions — Aisha will handle; she will need a draft SOW and a standard PO-friendly invoice. Can you attach a short sample SOW?

I'll put together the confirmed stakeholders and send an updated contact roster by Monday.

—Chris
Director of Product, NovaCorp
chris.nolan@novacorp.com | +1 206-555-0166
